title: Choose the visual world for Kana Dojo
question: The roll assigned Station Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Station Board
options.lineage: Japanese rail station name boards (ekimei-hyō) and Tokyo line-colour numbering
options.thesis: Every kana is a station: its name board is the flash card, its row is a line.
options.viewport: Top bar with Learn · Recall · Mix · Type · Stats; the study card is a station name board: giant kana, romaji beneath, neighbour kana as ← → stations, a line-colour band and a code ring (し = S02).
options.risk: Fifteen sets need fifteen distinguishable line colours; must stay a calm sign, not a theme-park transit costume.

raised.raise: Every rule is one hairline weight; each screen uses ink, ground, and only its own line colour.
Home is the route map: each script is a line of 15 set-stations, the current set focused, the whole line legible.
One alert colour reserved for misses only, held on the missed kana until it is answered right.
No card chrome around the kana: the sign panel is the only frame.
Heat-map cells repack whole on narrow widths and never shrink below legible.

options.label: Practice Sheet
options.lineage: Japanese kana practice notebooks (renshū-chō, genkō yōshi masu grids)
options.thesis: The practice notebook: every kana sits in its ruled square with crosshair guides.
options.viewport: The kana in one big guide-ruled square, three answer buttons below; the dashboard heat map is a masu grid; passes are marked with a red-pen circle.
options.risk: Paper and red pen is familiar, close to the warm study-notebook default many tools land on.

options.label: Kana Specimen
options.thesis: Each kana shown as a type specimen: one enormous glyph, the full gojuon grid beneath.
options.viewport: Giant kana fills two-thirds of the screen, tiny mono readouts for streak and stats; the whole syllabary sits below as a specimen grid that doubles as the heat map.
options.case: Strong on clarity (glyph-first, grid = heat map); a beginner does not identify with type foundries.
options.risk: Can feel like a design tool rather than a learning one.

options.label: Midnight Transit Map
options.thesis: Progress as a midnight-blue network map.
options.viewport: Sets drawn as coloured lines on a dark map.
options.risk: A network of sets reads less clearly than the gojuon grid.
options.case: Overlaps the roll's world; loses on clarity for the heat map.
options.kept: Focus the current corridor while keeping the whole line visible (the route map).

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference
options.thesis: Dense twin columns around a vermilion key rail.
options.viewport: Two small-type columns with a rail of keys.
options.risk: Reads as a book, not a drill.
options.case: Beginners don't identify with scholarly apparatus; dense text hurts clarity.
options.kept: One hairline weight everywhere; three values per screen.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.thesis: Lessons as passes, weak spots as a reranking board.
options.viewport: A pass for the lesson beside a live board of weak kana.
options.risk: Travel metaphor has nothing to do with kana.
options.case: No audience link; ranking board is useful but the pass is noise.
options.kept: One alert colour reserved for changes (misses), held until noticed.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Flat tiles and giant cropped lowercase.
options.viewport: Panorama of tiles; giant headers cropped off edge.
options.risk: Cropping fights the need to see the whole kana.
options.case: Cropped type harms recognition; no audience link.
options.kept: Chrome deleted so the glyph itself is the interface.

options.label: Circle Catalog
options.thesis: A dense newsprint grid of stamp-size cells.
options.viewport: Hundreds of tiny cells keyed to a hall map.
options.risk: Too dense and noisy for a calm beginner tool.
options.case: Density works for the heat map only; loses identification and calm.
options.kept: Whole-cell grid repacking; marked state persisted per cell.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean flash card app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centred rounded card with the kana, three buttons, a progress bar on top.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every flash card app by design.
